title: Allosteric and Energetic Remodeling by Protein Domain Extensions
authors: Hidalgo-Carcedo C; Faure AJ; Martí-Aranda A; Zarin T; Lehner B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过大规模突变能量测量研究PDZ结构域延伸对能量景观和别构效应的影响，虽涉及蛋白-配体结合，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且方法为实验测量而非AI或物理模拟，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Many functions of proteins are performed by independently folding structural units called domains. The structures of domains are conserved during evolution but they are not identical. For example, the >270 human PDZ domains vary in the number of secondary structure elements and in the length of loops. An important but largely unexplored question is the impact of these extensions on protein energy landscapes: beyond any immediate functional effects, do extensions also alter the consequences of perturbations elsewhere in the domain, altering the potential for regulation and evolvability? Here we perform massively parallel energetic measurements on a model human PDZ domain to directly and comprehensively answer this question. In total we quantify the binding to a ligand and abundance of ∼190,000 protein variants to quantify free energy changes for mutations throughout the canonical domain fold and ∼7,000 energetic couplings between these mutations and the two domain extensions, both alone and in combination. We find that both extensions—one structured and one more dynamic—substantially and specifically re-shape the energy landscape of the domain, with the removal of an ɑ-helix altering the energetic consequences of 424 mutations in 54 sites on fold stability and 420 mutations in 56 sites on binding to a ligand. These changes to the energy landscape alter the effects of 330 allosteric mutations, including at solvent-accessible surface sites. Extending or pruning the domain therefore reshapes its energetic and allosteric landscape, adding and removing opportunities for the allosteric control of protein function.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质的许多功能由称为结构域（domain）的独立折叠结构单元执行。结构域的结构在进化过程中是保守的，但并非完全相同。例如，人类超过270个PDZ结构域在二级结构元件的数量和环的长度上存在差异。一个重要但尚未充分探索的问题是，这些延伸对蛋白质能量景观的影响：除了任何直接的功能效应外，延伸是否也改变了结构域其他位置扰动的后果，从而影响调控潜力和可进化性？在此，我们对一个模型人类PDZ结构域进行了大规模并行能量测量，以直接且全面地回答这一问题。我们总共量化了约190,000个蛋白质变体与配体的结合及丰度，以量化整个经典结构域折叠中突变引起的自由能变化，以及这些突变与两个结构域延伸（单独及组合）之间的约7,000个能量耦合。我们发现，两种延伸——一种结构化，一种更具动态性——均显著且特异性地重塑了结构域的能量景观，其中去除一个α-螺旋改变了54个位点上424个突变对折叠稳定性的能量后果，以及56个位点上420个突变对配体结合的能量后果。这些能量景观的变化改变了330个变构突变（包括溶剂可及表面位点上的突变）的效应。因此，延伸或修剪结构域会重塑其能量和变构景观，增加或移除蛋白质功能变构控制的机会。
